Patch 16.22 (u.gg calls it 26.22). Pulled 2026-11-17.
coachless WPA: NA Diamond+ 1,775 games, all regions Diamond+ 19,646.
u.gg NA: All 36.3K, Diamond+ 2,229, Master+ 771, Challenger 168 games.
My pick for NA Diamond+ and up

It is the most bought first item and the worst one
in all three coachless samples (tab 3).

Exhaust over Barrier, Steelcaps vs AD,
Guardian Angel 3rd. Hold Condemn for the diver.

Your W already burns max HP. Keep Cut Down,
rush Terminus or Lord Dominik's 3rd.

Blade start, Resolve second, farm to 2 items.
Bloodthirster late for sustain.

Mercury's Treads, then Wit's End or
Mercurial if one CC spell kills you.

• Lethal Tempo, Flash + Barrier: what 3 of 4 players run, and
nothing beats them clearly. Safe.
• Doran's Blade, Cut Down, Bloodline, no Ruined King first:
the same lean in every big sample. Leans, not proof.
• Comp swaps: reasoning from Vayne's kit plus item WPA in all
games. coachless's "vs champion" filter is paid.

Share of games (u.gg NA) · win rate

• Lethal Tempo is the keystone: 78% of NA Diamond+
games and level with or above the rest in every
big sample.
• Press the Attack's +2.13 in NA Diamond+ is 286
games. All regions it is −0.45 over 3.7K. Not a
switch.

• Cut Down beats Coup de Grace and Bloodline beats
Alacrity in all four coachless samples I pulled
(NA and all regions, Emerald+ and Diamond+).
• Inspiration second: u.gg Diamond+ 55.4% win rate
on ~383 games, and Triple Tonic +4.77 (1.0K), Cash
Back +1.27 on coachless. A lean to try in safe
lanes. Resolve (Overgrowth −0.40) stays the
default into poke and dive.

All ranks: Doran's Bow
25,287 games, 49.7% win
coachless, slot "1st" only. Share = % of first items.

• Doran's Blade over Bow: +1.35 vs −0.31 all
regions Diamond+, and u.gg's pick from Diamond+
up. The 80 HP matters with only 550 range.
• Ruined King first is a third of first items
and below zero everywhere: −3.11 NA, −1.51 all
regions.
• Kraken Slayer is the safe first item (above
zero in all three samples).
• Essence Reaver leads all regions (+1.75) but
is flat in NA. Take it if you go crit.
• Yun Tal's +5.69 is 124 games. Ignore it for
now.

coachless WPA · buys. Items under ~1% of buys are hidden.

On-hit: 748 finished games
Kraken Slayer > Berserker's > Rageblade (Diamond+); Ruined
King > Berserker's > Rageblade (All ranks)

Crit: 554 finished games
Essence Reaver > Berserker's > Fiendhunter Bolts (Diamond+)

Kraken + Stormrazor: 952 finished games
Kraken Slayer > Gluttonous Greaves > Stormrazor (Diamond+)

Finished-build win rates favour late builds, so I only use
the split.

• No item stands out by much. The spread from best
to worst big item is about 2.5 pp, so buy for the
game in front of you.
• Lord Dominik's (+1.21) and Terminus (+0.50) lead
all regions as late picks (armor pen for the
damage that is not W). NA Diamond+ disagrees on
Terminus (−1.70 on 549).

• Ruined King is below zero in any slot too
(−1.33). Skip it unless you have a reason.
• Boots: Berserker's is ~85% of buys and flat. The
defensive boots that people buy for a reason sit
higher (+1.2 to +2.0), which is the point of tab
6.

coachless WPA · picks. Flash is in ~100% of games, so its WPA means nothing.
Slow 40% and cut their damage 35% for 3 s, 240 s
24% to 51% move speed for 10 s, 240 s
Remove disables (not airborne or suppression), 240 s

• Flash + Barrier is the default: 73% of
Diamond+ games, and the only second spell NA
Diamond+ lists (+1.61).
• Exhaust is the one that leans up all regions
(+1.22 on 2.8K). People take it into assassins
and divers, so read it as "Exhaust works there",
not "always Exhaust".
• Cleanse is below zero (−0.61). Into heavy CC,
Mercury's or Mercurial do the job without giving
up Barrier.
• u.gg Challenger's top pair is Cleanse + Flash
on 12 games. That is noise.

LoL wiki, abilities as of V26.20

Range 550: short for an ADC.
Q  Tumble: 300-unit dash, next attack +75% to 115% AD.
Cooldown 6 to 2 s
W  Silver Bolts: every 3rd hit on the same target deals 4%
to 10% of max HP as true damage (min 40 to 100)
E  Condemn: 550 range knockback 475 units; stun 1.5 s if
they hit a wall. Cooldown 20 to 12 s
R  Final Hour: +35 to 65 AD for 8 to 12 s, Tumble cooldown
cut 30% to 50% and gives 1 s stealth. Cooldown 100 to 70 s

They reach you before your 550 range matters. You live by
Tumble + R stealth and a Condemn on the diver.
−0.14 (1.8K): flat, but it buys a second fight

Your best matchup. W true damage scales with their max HP,
so more hits = more melted tanks.

Caitlyn, Miss Fortune and bot-lane mages are your worst
lanes on u.gg (40% to 41% on 56 to 74 games; mages are
tinier samples). Survive to 2 items.

One root or stun and you cannot Tumble. Tenacity and a
cleanse item beat the Cleanse spell here.

The numbers are each pick in all games (coachless's "vs champion" filter is paid),
so they show the pick is fine, not that it wins that matchup.
The comp logic comes from the kit.
